description: §14.8.10 (S456) — control for E-TENANT-UNDECLARED on a live database: the file holds `assets` (tenant_id, declared by `tables=`) and `audit_log` (no tenant_id). Compiles; the `assets` read is filtered at the source.
rationale: §14.8.10: a relation in a live database is charged only when it carries `tenant_id` outside the compilation's tenant set; the `<db tables=>` registry declares `assets`.
